title: The home of the unlock answer and of the asset reference, the announcement of the release, and the trigger of FEAT-AST-02 are not specified for rwb-treatment
source: Legacy RWB-E3-014 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md, heading RWB-E3-014); FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.14.1 to A2.14.4 (FEAT-TRT-14); TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.0, T3.1, T4 and T5.3; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIL-22, R-DIL-23 and R-DIL-24; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 rows FEAT-TRT-14 and FEAT-AST-02; Context pack S2 (service, ownership rows, Events row EV-10, Workflows row TreatmentWorkflow); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-01, DP-03, DP-05 and DP-12, R7.2 s12
section: 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow steps 4 to 9; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC3; 11 Data; 12.3; 12.5; 13 Solution plan; 19 Out of scope
description: One combined row for the application slice of the unlock. (1) TSD S2 T3.1 gives treatment DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033 and has no inspection outcome, no unlock answer, no unlock instant and no asset reference, so the four facts the step produces have no field and no column in the table the legacy story's data section names; the FSD A2.14.2 gives no store at all. (2) No source names an event for the release of the asset for transfer or for the asset reaching the asset list: the context pack gives the service one event, EV-10, TSD S2 T5.3 names TreatmentApproved as published, and Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 gives R-DIL-23 no downstream event, so the release cannot be announced on a published name. (3) FEAT-AST-02 of rwb-asset takes a property onto the books by asset_key when a deed-in-lieu transfer completes and depends on FEAT-TRT-14, but no source states what triggers it, which case fact it reads, or which service publishes the completion. (4) The legacy data table lists v_ace_npa_asset (DF-ACE-208 to DF-ACE-219) as the source of the asset facts, while Architecture v5 grants the recovery.v_ace_* views to rwb-source-data alone and the connection matrix gives rwb-treatment no call to rwb-source-data, so no source states how the step obtains the facts.
evidence: FSD S2 v3 A2.14.1 ('Applies the auto-unlock rule so the asset moves to the asset list without a person for the cases that qualify'), A2.14.2 ('Integration points. Workbench, AMIS'), A2.14.3.1 (R-DIL-22 'Run the asset unlock rule', R-DIL-23 'Release the asset for transfer') and A2.14.4.1 AC-S2-014-01; legacy RWB-E3-014 acceptance criteria AC1 to AC4 and data table row 'v_ace_npa_asset | asset_ref, asset_key, asset_code, transfer_in_type, from_segment, book_value and 6 more | DF-ACE-208 to DF-ACE-219'; TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033, no inspection, unlock or asset column), T4 (R-DIL-22 INSPECTION_COMPLETED to ASSET_UNLOCK_DECISION, R-DIL-23 AUTO_UNLOCK_PASSED to AWAITING_TRANSFER) and T5.3 ('TreatmentApproved | Published'); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIL-22 and R-DIL-23; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 row FEAT-AST-02 ('Links the case to the property in v_ace_npa_asset, which ACE ingests from AMIS, by asset_key when a deed in lieu transfer completes', depends on FEAT-TRT-14); Context pack S2 ownership rows (Events 1: EV-10; Workflows 1: TreatmentWorkflow); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-01, DP-03, DP-05, DP-12
area: Data and event: home of the unlock facts, announcement of the release, trigger of the asset-list entry, source of the ACE NPA-asset facts
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-treatment with the rwb-asset, rwb-source-data and rwb-case owners
proposed: Apply the working read of ASM-B2-S2-009-1, ASM-B2-S2-009-3 and ASM-B2-S2-009-4 in RWB-S2-E3014-APP: the answer, its instant, the inspection outcome and the asset reference are four optional treatment columns added on the service's own Flyway sequence and shared with the sibling deed-in-lieu element set; the release is reported to the parent CaseWorkflow and rwb-asset links the property under FEAT-AST-02 on the case fact, with no event of this service invented; the NPA-asset facts arrive on the case signal and no recovery.v_ace_* view is named by this service. Confirm with the rwb-asset owner that FEAT-AST-02 reads the case fact and not a service event, and with the P1 owner of the ACE views that the fact set of DF-ACE-208 to DF-ACE-219 is what the signal must carry, at the wave 2 contract freeze.

title: The field list, the value domain and the home of the unlock element, and the announcement of the release, have no published shape
source: Ambiguity across FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.14; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.1, T4, T5.3 and T-A.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIL-22 and R-DIL-23; legacy RWB-E3-014 sections 7, 11 and 19; Context pack S2 ownership rows; Template and Rules v1 R3 and R5.5 DP-03, DP-05 and DP-13
section: 3 Preconditions; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC6; 8 Business rules; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.3; 12.7; 13 Solution plan
description: One combined row for the contract slice. (1) No source publishes the element the unlock answer is carried on: TSD S2 T3.1 gives treatment fields, TSD S2 T-A.1 gives four treatment paths with no request or response field list, and the FSD describes the unlock only as a rule action, so the six properties, their required set and their types are defined nowhere. (2) No source fixes the value domain of the answer: the routing workbook names the events AUTO_UNLOCK_PASSED and AUTO_UNLOCK_FAILED and TSD S2 T4 repeats them, while no list of values, no width and no closed set is given for a column that holds the answer. (3) No source states whether the answer is carried on the existing treatment read or on an operation of its own, so the boundary between this element and the treatment resource has to be chosen. (4) No source names an event for the release of the asset for transfer, and no source states whether the answer is announced at all, so the document can only declare none.
evidence: TSD S2 v2 T-A.1 (API-S2-001 to API-S2-004, no unlock path), T-A.2 (Request TreatmentRequest, Response Treatment, no field list), T3.1 (DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033, no unlock column), T3.2 (the six lists, none for the unlock answer), T4 (R-DIL-22 and R-DIL-23 with their events) and T5.3 ('TreatmentApproved | Published'); FSD S2 v3 A2.14.2 and A2.14.3.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIL-22 and R-DIL-23; legacy RWB-E3-014 section 11 (treatment, decision_log_entry, rule_row) and section 19 (POST /cases/{caseId}/treatments, GET /treatments/{treatmentId}); Context pack S2 ownership rows (Events 1: EV-10); Template and Rules v1 R3 source precedence, R5.5 DP-03, DP-05 and DP-13, R7.2 s12
area: Contract: element field list, required set, value domain of the answer, path boundary, event
owner_role: Solution architect with the rwb-treatment tech lead and the P7 owner of the rule packages
proposed: Publish the working read of ASM-B2-S2-009-7, ASM-B2-S2-009-8 and ASM-B2-S2-009-9 in RWB-S2-E3014-CON: AssetUnlock with inspectionOutcome, unlockDecision, unlockDecidedAt, assetRef, ruleId and ruleVersion, three required once the step has run; unlockDecision published as a width carrying the event code the package returned and never a list the contract holds; the element a component of the treatment representation of RWB-S2-E3001-CON on GET /treatments/{treatmentId} with no path of its own and no new right; no event declared for the unlock or the release; no table created, the four facts recorded on treatment and the record the library's. Confirm the value domain with the P7 owner of the DEEDINLIEU package and the boundary with the rwb-treatment tech lead at the wave 2 contract freeze.
